basic_profile.bio: Avid FIFA player from Austin, TX, who spends most evenings and weekends exploring the intricacies of Ultimate Team. By day, I work as a software developer, and by night, I'm either on the pitch or discussing tactics online. I'm passionate about digital security and often help friends understand the basics. When I'm not gaming, you might find me at the local disc golf course, enjoying some fresh air. Currently single, but always open to meeting fellow gamers.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in computer science and a keen interest in gaming, I've spent years honing my understanding of both the technical and gameplay aspects of video games. My programming skills are mostly self-taught, although I did study computer science at university. I also keep up-to-date with the latest security practices, which helps me maintain the integrity of my online accounts.
